source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass attic API, boundary=administrative + admin_level=9 (ward)
role: EVALUATION ONLY — the spatial unit predictions and incident reports are both aggregated to. Never a model input.
note: Wards whose outer ways could not be stitched into a closed ring are omitted. Ward boundaries in OSM are community-mapped and may not match the official cadastre exactly; they are used here as a consistent unit, not as a legal boundary.
